Consider the diagram that is shown above. Which of the following is true?
worked_solution:
Two vectors are equal if and only if they lie on parallel lines and have both the same magnitude and the same direction.

The vectors $c$ and $d$ have opposite directions, hence, $c\ne d.$ 

So, the only equal vectors are $a=b=e.$

Question 5
?

Consider the diagram that is shown above. Which of the following is true?

a
a=e only
b
a=b only
c
a=b=e only
d
b=e only
e
a=b=e and c=d
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Two vectors are equal if and only if they lie on parallel lines and have both the same magnitude and the same direction.

The vectors c and d have opposite directions, hence, c≠d.

So, the only equal vectors are a=b=e.
